sources.title: dots.tts-base: Text-to-Audio model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview dots.tts-base is a 2-billion-parameter fully continuous, end-to-end autoregressive text-to-speech system developed by rednote-hilab. The model combines a semantic encoder, a language model initialized from Qwen2.5-1.5B-Base, and an autoregressive flow-matching acoustic head operating over a 48 kHz AudioVAE with no discrete codec tokens in the pipeline.
